name: B10-0118/2026 (PfE) – Targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks Türkiye to release jailed Swedish journalist Joakim Medin and to stop arresting, detaining or expelling foreign journalists. It asks Türkiye to protect Christians and other religious minorities from discrimination and expulsion, and to respect press freedom and freedom of religion. It also asks the EU's diplomatic service to watch trials of detained journalists and Christian leaders and to raise these cases with Turkish authorities.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states demands to Türkiye.
- Affects foreign journalists, Christian workers and families in Türkiye.
- Next: EU diplomats watch trials and raise cases with Türkiye.
